---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Leiksvæði
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
Describe the problem you're trying to solve. What current limitation or issue would this feature address?

## 💭 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. How would this feature work?

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 👥 User Benefit
Who would benefit from this feature? How would it improve the user experience?

## 📱 Device/Platform Considerations
- Would this feature work on mobile devices?
- Are there any platform-specific considerations?

## 🏗️ Implementation Ideas
If you have ideas about how this could be implemented technically, share them here.

## 📸 Mockups or Examples
If you have mockups, sketches, or examples from other apps, feel free to share them.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, links, or information about the feature request here.

## 🔥 Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would be helpful
- [ ] Important for my use case
- [ ] Critical/blocking
